settings.heading: Shipping
settings.body:
Every MEQENET piece is printed and sewn when you order it. Nothing sits in a warehouse, which means a short wait before your order ships and very little waste behind it.

Production

Two to five business days for most items. Embroidered pieces can take a day or two longer.

Transit

Once the piece leaves the production facility, domestic orders usually arrive in three to five business days. International times vary by destination.

Tracking

You'll get a tracking link by email as soon as the order ships. If it hasn't arrived within a week of that email, write to us.

Rates

Shipping is calculated at checkout against your address. Orders over the free-shipping threshold ship at no cost.

Customs

International orders may be subject to import duties collected by your local carrier. Those charges are set by your country, not by us.
